{{Top|leg}}
A '''dropsuit''' was a type of combat-rated [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] that was used for penetrating the defenses of locations in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Both a combat-ready suit of airtight [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and a self-contained weapons system, it was armed with mini-missiles and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

==History==
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] used a dropsuit to penetrate the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] defenses of [[Nickel One]], in the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]], in order to find and kill her brother, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]. With the suit's weaponry, she was able to shoot down two [[Starhunter|TIE Starhunters]] while ''en route'' to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
